All 29 tests pass. The solution is implemented in `yacht.h` and `yacht.cpp`:

- **`yacht.h`** declares `int score(std::initializer_list<int> dice, const std::string& category)` in the `yacht` namespace.
- **`yacht.cpp`** counts occurrences of each face (1–6) and the total, then dispatches on the category string:
  - `ones`–`sixes`: face value × count of that face
  - `full house`: total only when some face shows exactly 3 and another exactly 2 (so a Yacht or four-of-a-kind scores 0)
  - `four of a kind`: 4 × the face with ≥4 occurrences (a Yacht scores this as 4 × face)
  - `little straight` / `big straight`: 30 only when faces 1–5 or 2–6 each appear exactly once
  - `choice`: sum of all dice
  - `yacht`: 50 only when all five dice match
